title: Questions 151-152 refer to the following company policy.
passage_1:
External Events: Accommodation and Materials Policy

Employees attending external events must follow the guidelines below regarding accommodation and materials. For conferences held over 100 kilometres from the office, the company will cover the cost of a hotel up to €120 per night. However, for events within a 100-kilometre radius, overnight stays are not funded, since staff are expected to travel home the same evening.

Concerning printed materials, an allowance of €60 per event is available to those attending the full program. Itemised invoices must be provided. In particular cases, such as when an employee is presenting on the company’s behalf, a higher limit may be authorized by a division head.
